In [[mathematics]], in the [[Group_theory#Finite_group_theory|theory of finite groups]], a '''Brauer tree''' is a [[Tree (graph theory)|tree]] that encodes the [[Character (mathematics)|characters]] of a [[Modular representation theory#Blocks and the structure of the group algebra|block]] with [[cyclic group|cyclic]] [[defect group]] of a [[finite group]].  In fact, the trees encode the [[group ring|group algebra]] up to [[Morita equivalence]].  Such algebras coming from Brauer trees are called Brauer tree algebras.

{{harvtxt|Feit|1984}} described the possibilities for Brauer trees.
